title: Spec 19 requirements verification matrix
description: Create a verification matrix mapping all 75 normative requirements from spec/19-device-ux.md to their implementation status, test coverage, and tier applicability. For each requirement: (1) is it implemented? (2) is there a test? (3) which tiers does it apply to? The matrix lives in the repo (e.g. docs/spec19-verification.md or a test fixture). Critical testable assertions: hold feedback within 500ms (§4), SOS reachable in ≤1 interaction from every screen (§8), no periodic refresh (§6), LED table has exactly 6 states (§10). Update this matrix as implementation progresses.
